Chapter 892: Chapter 26 The Eleventh Time Travel (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 892: Chapter 26 The Eleventh Time Travel (Subscribe Please)

Merit Points are linked to one’s contribution to the overall human civilization.

And imposing an unparalleled deterrence on alien races, especially the peak races, is also beneficial to the expansion of human civilization.

Even greater than the intimidation by supreme powerhouses.

At least the supreme powerhouses of human civilization have the ability to resist the major peak race powers.

But the Galaxy Master?

What can Level Eleven resist against?

Judging by the Galaxy Master’s performance on super-large battlefields, who can compete except the Twelve-Star ultimate beings?

Absolute invincibility brings utter despair to the Level Eleven of the many peak races.

“Over two hundred billion Merit Points…” Lin Yuan’s face showed a smile.

Such a tremendous amount of Merit Points left him momentarily unsure of how to use them.

“First, let’s raise my citizen rank to Tenth-Level.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

From a Ninth-Level Citizen to a Tenth-Level Citizen requires fifty billion Merit Points.

Before the opening of the super-large battlefield, Lin Yuan had never imagined he could amass such a quantity of Merit Points in a short time.

He estimated it would only be possible after unlocking the complete Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter.

But now?

Fifty billion Merit Points?

It’s just a quarter of the excess of two hundred billion.

With Lin Yuan’s citizen rank increase.

Soon, his Merit Points balance decreased by fifty billion.

And Lin Yuan’s citizen rank, in half a breath, changed from ‘Ninth-Level’ to ‘Tenth-Level’.

“Tenth-Level Citizen.”

Lin Yuan’s eyes were bright.

As far as he knew, the highest citizen rank of human civilization is the Eleventh-Level Citizen.

As for the Twelfth-Level Citizen? In theory, a Twelfth-Level Citizen could control the entire human civilization.

But in reality, it is just a theory, and advancing to a Twelfth-Level Citizen is not just a matter of Merit Points.

Even as an Eleventh-Level Citizen, there are only nine in human civilization—the nine supreme powerhouses.

Therefore…

A Tenth-Level Citizen is essentially the most revered citizen just below the supreme powerhouses of human civilization.

Even the supreme powerhouses will not overlook a Tenth-Level Citizen, as each has made indelible contributions to human civilization.

The current Tenth-Level Citizens still alive in human civilization are very few, all from before the Starry Sea Era, citizens of the dormant years of human civilization.

In fact, during the dormant years of human civilization, obtaining Merit Points was much easier compared to the Starry Sea Era.

After all, at that time, human civilization was not the peak civilization that now sweeps across various alien races. Even with the ultimate opportunity, it was like walking on thin ice, and naturally, the threshold for Merit Points distribution was lower.

In a sense, Lin Yuan is the first Tenth-Level Citizen born since the beginning of the Starry Sea Era.

Fifty billion Merit Points, even those evolutionary scholars who are adept at acquiring Merit Points, couldn’t gather that amount in over two million years.

“Hmm?”

“The Supreme President of human civilization is looking for me?”

Lin Yuan raised his eyebrows, noticing a video call request.

The Supreme President of human civilization is a position, similar to a Planetary Governor, rotated every few years.

Still, citizens who can serve as the Supreme President are impeccable in every aspect, after all, it’s the highest visible leader of human civilization.

Assisting the three goddesses in governing the vast human civilization.

And the supreme powerhouses… Generally, supreme powerhouses do not interfere in the routine affairs of human civilization, except in situations specified in the charter where the three goddesses will consult the supreme powerhouses first.

Supreme powerhouses are more a symbol of spiritual significance for human civilization.

Of course, the fact that supreme powerhouses do not interfere in the routine affairs of humanity is because they couldn’t be bothered; in reality, they wield a lot of power within human civilization.

“Respected Galaxy Master…”

The video connected, and an elderly man with white hair saluted Lin Yuan on the virtual screen.

In terms of strength, Lin Yuan is an existence second only to a Twelve-Star being, not only in human civilization but also in the entire Cosmic Starry Skies.

In terms of citizen rank, Lin Yuan is now a Tenth-Level Citizen and the first Tenth-Level Citizen since the start of the Starry Sea Era, with an extremely revered meaning and status.

Even the Supreme President, facing Lin Yuan, must show respect.

“Hmm…”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Then he briefly chatted with the Supreme President.

The main purpose of this video call from the Supreme President was to congratulate Lin Yuan on becoming a Tenth-Level Citizen.

And by the way, the Supreme President introduced Lin Yuan personally to the many benefits and treatments of a Tenth-Level Citizen.

The basic benefits for a Tenth-Level Citizen are an elevated version of those for a Ninth-Level Citizen, encompassing all aspects. Even if Lin Yuan intends to serve as the Supreme President, he has a full ten percent certainty.

The discount for purchasing various resources and weapons has also reached sixty percent.

This sixty percent applies to everything, even exchanging for supreme weapons, Twelve-Star rarities, etc., at the discounted exchange value.

Equivalent to a loss-making exchange from human civilization for you.

“Not bad at all.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Let’s set aside all the other upgraded version benefits for now. The mere six-fold exchange rate is enough to break even. Given Lin Yuan’s demand for resources during cultivation, it’s only a matter of time before he earns back the value of twelve-star treasures worth fifty billion merit points.

“Hmm?”

“The many privileges in the Virtual World have also been enhanced?”

Lin Yuan explored and discovered that after becoming a Tenth-Level Citizen, if he wished, he could know the personal information of any citizen he saw.

As far as the Tenth-Level Citizens within human civilization are concerned, there are virtually no secrets left.

“The ultimate chance…”

Lin Yuan looked at the information about the ultimate chance.

This so-called ultimate chance was the greatest opportunity human civilization had received from the descent of countless heritages from beyond the universe before it entered seclusion.

The ultimate chance led to the birth of nine of the strongest beings in human civilization; moreover, many fortunes have also allowed the development of human civilization to this day, with most of the Clan Suppression Weapons and even its foundation originating from that ultimate chance.

“The tenth ultimate evolutionary pathway?”

Lin Yuan’s heart twitched slightly. Among the ultimate chances obtained by human civilization, the most important were ten ultimate evolutionary pathways.

The ten ultimate evolutionary pathways mentioned here do not have any ultimate beings, and their value is beyond measure. The paths taken by the nine strongest beings of human civilization are among these nine pathways.

The tenth ultimate evolutionary pathway is exceedingly special and obscure, and so far, no one from human civilization has successfully traversed it to reach the ultimate level.

“Entirely different from the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway.”

After browsing through it, Lin Yuan realized that he automatically acquired this ultimate evolutionary pathway after becoming a Tenth-Level Citizen.

Within the entire human civilization, only citizens with significant contributions can hope to be gifted with this evolutionary path, while the other nine ultimate evolutionary pathways are widely disseminated.

This is because there are ultimate beings presiding over them. In contrast, this ultimate evolutionary pathway is the path to the twelfth level, and it will not be disseminated until a sufficient number of Level Eleven Perfect beings are born.

After Lin Yuan received this ultimate evolutionary pathway, he also saw the number of cultivators practicing this pathway; only over a hundred, with the strongest among them at the Fourth Stage of Level Eleven.

“Pity…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. This ultimate evolutionary pathway does not cultivate the physical body, soul, or internal world, but aims to analyze all things, the Cosmic Starry Skies, and the Chaos Void as its ultimate goals.

Although it has a high potential limit, the path Lin Yuan pioneered – the Martial Tao evolutionary – is distinctly different, even bearing little resemblance for reference.

…

“This is what it means to be a Tenth-Level Citizen…”

Lin Yuan broadly understood all privileges and benefits of being a Tenth-Level Citizen.

In summary, it could be described in four words:

“Do as one pleases.”

A Tenth-Level Citizen, especially one who ascends through the most formal means after the Starry Sea Era begins, can basically do anything within human civilization.

There were some Tenth-Level Citizens before Lin Yuan, but they were all born before the Starry Sea Era; the thresholds they crossed and the privileges they enjoy are not the same as Lin Yuan’s.

To put it simply, the privileges that the Tenth-Level Citizens before Lin Yuan enjoyed can be considered a ‘castrated version’ of what Lin Yuan now enjoys.

…

“There is nothing pressing at the moment.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts, “I can undertake the eleventh traversal now.”

If it were not for the need for him to preside over the super-large battlefield, Lin Yuan would have likely started his eleventh traversal decades ago.

Though the outcome of the super-large battlefield had been determined ninety years earlier, to ensure absolute certainty, Lin Yuan waited until the war was completely concluded before he began to prepare for the next traversal.

Thinking this, Lin Yuan’s spirit sank into the depths of his consciousness and arrived in front of the majestic and venerable Myriad Realms Gate.

“Let’s set this traversal to take place in the Immortal Realm.”

Lin Yuan made the decision in his heart.

The Immortal Realm, as a superior world to the Spirit Realm, was revealed to Lin Yuan upon ascending to the Ninth Layer of Heaven in the Spirit Realm, where he discovered a corner of that vast world towering above the Spirit Realm.

By obtaining the world coordinates, this is identified as the Immortal Realm.

According to the intelligence information Lin Yuan gathered in the Spirit Realm, whether it’s the Spirit Realm or the even lower Central Divine China World, both are influenced by the Immortal Realm.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path, who once wandered billions of worlds in dreams, propagated the Immortal Cultivation System.

And the Ancestor of the Immortal Path… is the only ultimate existence beyond the Main Universe that Lin Yuan is aware of.

The ultimate domain where the Ancestor of the Immortal Path stands tall is the very Immortal Path itself.

“During the traversal, my true self will continue to absorb resources and cultivate the ‘Body of Xuanhuang’…” Lin Yuan arranged numerous affairs.

Now, Lin Yuan’s practice of “Body of Xuanhuang” has inclined towards instinct, and even without the control of conscious will, he reflexively cultivates, devouring various resources to strengthen himself.

It’s just like how the heart continues to beat and body functions continue to operate even when one is asleep.

“This arrival in the Immortal Realm… my stay would last for two thousand one hundred years?”

“With the Main World’s time-speed ratio being one to twenty? Does that mean two thousand one hundred years in the Immortal Realm will result in one hundred years elapsing in the Main Universe?”

Lin Yuan sent out a strand of conscious will, following the coordinates of the Immortal Realm, briefly observed the vast world, and gleaned some information.

The one-to-twenty time-speed ratio indicates that the Immortal Realm’s level is getting very close to that of the Main Universe.

“One hundred years… Announce that I will be in seclusion for the next hundred years.”

Lin Yuan made all the preparations and immediately initiated the eleventh traversal.

Buzz, buzz, buzz.

The Myriad Realms Gate faintly emitted fluctuations as Lin Yuan poured all his conscious will into the gate.
